title: Minnesota Sushi (Ham, Cream Cheese & Dill Pickle Pinwheels)
originalTitle: Minnesota Sushi (Ham, Cream Cheese & Dill Pickle Pinwheels)
ingredients: 8–10 slices deli ham (Carl Buddig corned beef/ham or deli honey ham), patted dry
8 oz block cream cheese, softened at room temperature
8–10 whole baby dill pickles or kosher dill spears, patted dry
Optional seasoning: 1/2 tsp garlic powder or Everything Bagel seasoning mixed into cream cheese
instructions: Lay each slice of ham flat on a cutting board and pat dry with a paper towel so the cream cheese adheres smoothly.
Spread an even layer of softened cream cheese edge-to-edge across each slice of ham.
Place a whole dill pickle spear at one edge and roll up tightly like a sushi maki roll.
Chill for 15 minutes to firm up, then slice into 1/2-inch bite-sized pinwheels.
notes: Doc Note: Minnesota sushi (cream cheese. Pickle. Carl Buddig ham).
